📺 Ozark (2017–2022)

🎬 TV Series
⭐️ Genre: Crime, Drama, Thriller
🎭 Starring: Jason Bateman, Laura Linney, Sofia Hublitz

📝 Summary:
Ozark follows Marty Byrde, a financial planner who is forced to move his family to the Ozarks after a money-laundering scheme for a Mexican drug cartel goes horribly wrong. To keep his family alive, Marty must launder millions of dollars while navigating dangerous criminals, local rivals, and increasingly complicated threats. As the pressure builds, his family becomes deeply involved in the criminal world.

🔥 Why Watch?

* Gripping crime and money-laundering storyline
* Outstanding performance by Jason Bateman
* Dark and suspenseful atmosphere
* Complex characters and intense family drama
* Constant twists and high-stakes decisions

🏆 Rating: 8.4/10 (IMDb)

⏱️ Runtime: 4 Seasons • 44 Episodes
